description: Free infinite canvas for notes, nested boards, and visual project planning.
pre_install: if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $payload -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'The embedded Electron app-64.7z payload was not found in the NSIS package.' }
post_install: if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $dir 'Odinote.exe') -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'Odinote.exe was not extracted into the Scoop version directory.' }
notes: Scoop extracts the official NSIS package and its embedded app-64.7z payload; the vendor installer routine is not executed.
The application stores its user data in the normal per-user Electron data directory, outside the Scoop version directory.

The extracted copy does not contain the vendor uninstall marker, which prevents its background updater from silently installing a separate copy outside Scoop. Update this package with Scoop (scoop update odinote); do not use the in-app installer update action.
